note: synthetic procedural civic landmark; not a real building and not modelled on one
height_rule: 30 + 40 * u, u = first 48 bits of sha256('landmark:height:<slug>'), rounded to 0.5 m

series-setback.form: square shaft, three setbacks, corner piers, tinted blade fins between glass bays, louvred lantern, emissive ring and needle spire

track-twist.form: stacked two-floor glass modules turning a few degrees per module around a mast, tinted corner piers and blades, floor plates, two tilted emissive rings

focus-rotunda.basis: worlds[].name ends in ' DAO' and zones[].source cites the PBC mission statement ('How It Works')
focus-rotunda.form: round drum shaft with one setback, radial tinted fins, limestone bands, a dome and a floating emissive ring

platform-prism.basis: none of the rules above (worlds whose zones cite their own source documents)
platform-prism.form: chamfered octagonal prism with a batter and one setback, tinted edge fins, glass main faces, stepped crown with emissive bands and a mast

tinting: facade/glass/stone textures are neutral and shared per style; the brand hue lives only in the LM_Fin_Tint (fins, inlays) and LM_Crown_Glow (emissive ring, bead) material factors and the plaque
plaque: the only text is the brand mark letters (alphanumerics of brand.mark), Pillow default sans (Aileron)
placement_rule: suggested, not applied: worldforge/build.mjs is not edited by this generator. Centre within |x| 7-18 m of the council road axis, north of the plaza (footprint >= 1 m off the plaza pad), >= 3 m clear of every blockout primitive, road and card volume in that world; nearest to the plaza first, east side on ties; yaw turns the +Z entrance to face the plaza centre. Apply as node translation + rotation about +Y.
